			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 220 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_consumer_contract value = 220 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_resource_treasury value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_resource_chargeback value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_type_code value = 220 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 220 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_consumer_contract value = 220 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7220 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m220_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 220 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_business_object_created = 1 }
		# Platform settlement also debits organization and manager atomically.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_funded value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_ledger_status value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:zg361_ip_m220_total_cost > 0
				var:zg361_case_z_owner = {
					government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
					treasury >= var:zg361_ip_m220_treasury_cost
					gold >= var:zg361_ip_m220_personal_cost
				}
			}
			var:zg361_case_z_owner = { remove_treasury = var:zg361_ip_m220_treasury_cost remove_short_term_gold = var:zg361_ip_m220_personal_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_treasury_paid value = var:zg361_ip_m220_treasury_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_personal_paid value = var:zg361_ip_m220_personal_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_paid_total value = var:zg361_ip_m220_total_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_funded value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_ledger_status value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_total_cost > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_cost_debt value = var:zg361_ip_m220_total_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_ledger_status value = 3 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = -4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m220_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_cost_debt value = var:zg361_ip_m220_showback_cost }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_ledger_status value = 3 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_value_metric_used value = var:zg361_ip_m219_net_value }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_consumer_charge_platform_cost value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m220_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_ip_m221_apply_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_choice value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner = { has_variable = zg361_mechanism_221_choice } }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_221_choice = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_choice value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_221_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_choice value = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner = { is_ai = yes is_at_war = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_choice value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_z_owner = { is_ai = yes stewardship < 10 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_choice value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_ip_m221_choice < 3
			NOT = {
trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m220_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m220_object_type_code

		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_prerequisite_deferred value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_active
			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_owner
			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_subject
			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_cycle

			var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind > 0
			var:zg361_ip_z_input_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_ip_z_input_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

			var:zg361_ip_z_input_consequence_kind = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind
			trigger_if = {

					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m221_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m221_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m221_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_z_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_z_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_z_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_z_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_z_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_z_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_z_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_z_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_z_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m221_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m221_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 221
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

		if = {

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m221_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m221_choice < 3 }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_user_share value = 30 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_reform_share value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_migration_hours value = 30 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m221_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_platform_share value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_user_share value = 100 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_reform_share value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_migration_hours value = 20 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_type_code value = 221 }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 221 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_consumer_contract value = 221 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_resource_platform_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_resource_user_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_resource_reform_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_type_code value = 221 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 221 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_consumer_contract value = 221 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7221 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m221_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 221 }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_cost_receipt_used value = var:zg361_ip_m220_funded }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_consumer_allocate_migration_cost value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }

				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m221_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}

			var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind > 0

			var:zg361_ip_z_input_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_ip_z_input_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_ip_z_input_incident_serial = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial
			var:zg361_ip_z_input_source_kind = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind
			var:zg361_ip_z_input_consequence_kind = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m222_done_state }
				OR = {
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m222_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m222_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m222_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m222_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m222_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_z_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_z_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_z_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_z_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_z_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_z_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_z_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_z_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_z_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m222_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m222_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m222_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m222_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m222_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m222_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m222_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 222
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m222_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m222_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m222_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_dual_run_hours value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_old_route_closed value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_exit_days value = 90 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m222_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_dual_run_hours value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_old_route_closed value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_exit_days value = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_type_code value = 222 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_dual_run_plan value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 222 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_consumer_contract value = 222 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_resource_user_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_resource_deadline value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_type_code value = 222 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 222 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_consumer_contract value = 222 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7222 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m222_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 222 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m222_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_migration_plan_used value = var:zg361_ip_m221_migration_hours }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_consumer_start_dual_run value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m222_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}
